dialogues.jp: 「さって……今日はパンにするか」
dialogues.en: "Hmm...... I guess I'll have some buns today."
dialogues.text: "Hmm...... I guess I'll have some buns today."

dialogues.jp:
席から立ち上がり、弁当の匂いが漂う教室から
出る。
dialogues.en:
I stood up and left the classroom with the smell of
everyone's lunch in my nose.
dialogues.text:
I stood up and left the classroom with the smell of
everyone's lunch in my nose.

dialogues.jp:
ゆっくり歩く奴らを足早に追い抜いて、購買へ
急ぐ。
dialogues.en: I passed a few students and hurried to the store.
dialogues.text: I passed a few students and hurried to the store.

dialogues.jp:
この時間なら、まだ余裕がある。買出しは出遅
れると悲惨だからな。
dialogues.en:
I still have plenty of time. If I'm too late, it'll be too
crowded inside of the store.
dialogues.text:
I still have plenty of time. If I'm too late, it'll be too
crowded inside of the store.

dialogues.jp: 廊下を出たところで、萌先輩と眞子に遭遇する。
dialogues.en:
When I went down to the lower floor, I found someone moving
a lot slower than the others.
dialogues.text:
When I went down to the lower floor, I found someone moving
a lot slower than the others.

dialogues.jp: ふたりとも今ごろ鍋の真最中なのでは？
dialogues.en: I walked up to her and stopped.
dialogues.text: I walked up to her and stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「今日は屋上でお昼を食べませんので、それを
　朝倉くんに伝えに行くところだったんです」
dialogues.en:
"I was going to tell you that we aren't going to eat on the
rooftop today."
dialogues.text:
"I was going to tell you that we aren't going to eat on the
rooftop today."

dialogues.jp: 俺は眞子のほうに顔を向けた。
dialogues.en: "Oh, I'm glad I bumped into you. Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'm glad I bumped into you. Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
そうこう話している間にも、付属の学生が姿を
現し、俺たちを追い抜いていく。
dialogues.en:
As she smiled softly at me, a group of students from the
affiliated school passed us by.
dialogues.text:
As she smiled softly at me, a group of students from the
affiliated school passed us by.

dialogues.jp: そろそろ行かないといけないか……
dialogues.en: I have to hurry on, don't I?......
dialogues.text: I have to hurry on, don't I?......

dialogues.jp:
購買にパンを買いに行く途中、萌先輩に会った。
今日は屋上で食べないことを伝えに来てくれた
のだ。
dialogues.en:
On my way to the store to buy some buns, I bumped into
Moe-sempai. She was coming to tell me that they aren't going
to eat lunch on the rooftop today.
dialogues.text:
On my way to the store to buy some buns, I bumped into
Moe-sempai. She was coming to tell me that they aren't going
to eat lunch on the rooftop today.

dialogues.jp:
先輩の気配りに感謝しつつ、購買のパンが気に
なる俺。
dialogues.en:
I was thankful for her thoughtfulness, but at the same time,
worried about my buns.
dialogues.text:
I was thankful for her thoughtfulness, but at the same time,
worried about my buns.
